question: Is REBOOT_NOT_DETECTED a false negative of the certification tool?
answer: NO — detector is correct; Windows boot identity did not change.

eventLog.event1074_6006_6008_afterFrozenBoot: NONE in last 2 days after 13:00 boot

fastStartup.note: Hybrid/Fast Startup is enabled. A Shutdown+power-on can feel like a reboot without updating LastBootUpTime. A true Restart should update boot identity; no Restart markers appear after 13:00.

detectorLogicAudit.reasonTimezoneNotCulprit: FileTimeUtc identical (timezone-independent); ISO strings also identical byte-for-byte including +02:00 offset
detectorLogicAudit.reason: Boot gate reads live WMI every run; does not trust staged startup-report for rebootDetected

rebootCertifyAfterOutputs.conclusion: REBOOT-CERTIFY-AFTER.cmd did not leave a completed evidence package under the staged install root

secondaryEvidenceGaps.note: These gaps do not cause REBOOT_NOT_DETECTED; boot gate fails independently on WMI identity.

exactRootCause: Windows reports the same LastBootUpTime/FileTimeUtc as the frozen pre-reboot identity (2026-08-12T13:00:34+02:00 / 134310060342830420). Independent Event Log Id 12/6005 agree. No post-13:00 restart/shutdown markers. Certification tool correctly refuses PASS.
guidanceWhenUserNextChoosesToValidate: Use Start → Restart (not Shutdown). Confirm LastBootUpTime changes before launching SCI OS. Then launch LOCALAPPDATA SCI-OS-X10.cmd only; after HOME+GW1 run REBOOT-CERTIFY-AFTER.cmd while evidence can be written.
